title: Night Road Murder Case
notes: Recurring detective-cast nodes (Conan, Kogoro Mouri, Ran, Inspector Megure, Detective Takagi) omitted by convention. No event nodes: every action is a directly typed edge between the entities involved, sharing an order integer. The strongest red herring is Masami Kusaka, who is actively framed by the culprit with a forged locker note and a faked recorded phone call, and is accused on-screen of the murder before the trajectory trick is uncovered; Nakamura is a secondary red herring via an alleged debt and an unaccounted-for absence. case_type: murder.

clues.desc: Blood is found at three aligned points -- a stain on the abandoned building's wall, blood on its roof railing directly above that stain, and blood on glass shards from Omura's shattered window one floor below Takeno's apartment -- tracing a single trajectory that only makes sense if a weapon was thrown from Takeno's window, bounced off the railing, and grazed Omura's window on a later practice throw.

The socks in Takeno's room are unusually thick mountaineering-grade socks, strong enough to hold packed rocks without tearing, and a thread of the same color is caught in his fish tank's water plant -- ties the improvised weapon directly back to him.

With the street lamp broken, the only visible marker in the dark was the glow of Ikuta's cigarette; Takeno had the lights off in his own room at exactly the same time, letting him track that glow through his window to aim the drop.
